title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-25
headline: The Los Angeles Dodgers clinch another division title and chase a three-peat

questions.prompt: Who won the National League West division title?
choices: The Los Angeles Dodgers
The Cincinnati Reds
The Atlanta Braves
The New York Yankees
The Boston Red Sox
questions.hintKo: The Dodgers won the division, defeating the Reds.

questions.prompt: What did the Dodgers achieve with their win?
choices: Their first ever division title
A place in a different league
Their thirteenth National League West title in fourteen seasons
A new stadium
The end of the season
questions.hintKo: The win gave the Dodgers a thirteenth division title in fourteen seasons.

questions.prompt: When did Landon Knack pitch four scoreless innings in relief?
choices: Two months earlier
The same day he was called up from the minor leagues
At the start of the season
In the middle of last year
He did not pitch at all
questions.hintKo: He was called up and pitched on the same day.

questions.prompt: Where does the winner of each Major League Baseball division go?
choices: Straight to a holiday
To a different sport
Into a training camp for next year
Into the playoffs
To a vote by fans
questions.hintKo: Division winners advance into the playoffs.

questions.prompt: Why is a three-peat difficult to achieve?
choices: The rules forbid it
Teams are not allowed to try
It requires playing in three different cities
It can only happen in other sports
It means winning the championship three years in a row, and injuries and the short playoff series make that very hard
questions.hintKo: Winning three years in a row is hard because of injuries and the unpredictable playoffs.

questions.prompt: How is the champion of Major League Baseball finally decided?
choices: By the number of home runs hit all year
By a vote of the coaches
By the postseason playoff tournament at the end of the year
By ticket sales
By the length of each game
questions.hintKo: The playoffs at the end of the season determine the champion.
